answer: In a market for vine health and ridge erosion reports, delay each job payout until a random audit window closes. Derive audit selection from a future public seed, so a fraud ring cannot know which reports will be checked when it commits them. Withhold enough earned revenue that audit probability times forfeiture exceeds the profit from fabrication. Each extra alias must risk its own withheld earnings; a ripple of new keys cannot cash out before inspection. Independent evidence and an appeal are needed to avoid punishing honest errors.
